h1: Custom Midweight T Shirts for Everyday Wear
metaTitle: Custom Midweight T Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom midweight t shirts in bulk for your team. Durable, comfortable fabric perfect for daily use.
introHtml: Midweight t shirts offer the ideal balance of durability and comfort for daily wear. Unlike lightweight tees that may feel flimsy after repeated washes, these 5.5–6.5 oz shirts hold their shape and color through industrial laundering. They are a smart choice for work uniforms, event staff, or any scenario where you need a shirt that looks professional without feeling stiff. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a polished finish.
